title: The secret story of the Bear
text: The BEAR games have a secret story. Do you know it?
Many years ago, two scientists worked in a very big factory. Their names were Sam and Whitey. The factory was called the Cheese Factory. But they did not only make cheese there...

Sam and Whitey worked in a secret laboratory. They wanted to create something new, so they started some strange experiments. In one of their experiments, they created the Bear. The Bear was huge, strong and very dangerous. Its body glowed with a red light.

The two scientists did not stop. They created many different bears. One day there was an accident in the factory and all the bears escaped. People called this moment the Bear Apocalypse. From that day, the bears looked for people everywhere.
That is why the survivors in the game are afraid. They live in dark and dangerous places, and they always listen carefully. Who is coming? Is it a friend... or is it the Bear?
q: What were the names of the two scientists?
What was the name of the factory?
Where did they do their experiments?
What happened one day in the factory?
Because the bears look for them
